mfa.title: Platform Security — Multi-Factor Authentication

mfa.warnUnverifiedVersion: Save response received, but current policy version could not be verified. Check again.
mfa.successVersion: New version verified from server. Native factor reconciliation is separately required.
mfa.errVerifyFailed: MFA policy could not be safely verified. Re-authenticate with a strong session or refresh the page.
